novelty_flags.label: Theorem 2 (whole-fiber coverage) and project-level related work
novelty_flags.one_line: Add StriederDrton2024, Identifying Total Causal Effects in Linear Models under Partial Homoscedasticity, and distinguish its closed-form structure-uncertainty regions from the proposed mixed-noise construction.

soundness_flags.label: ass:greatest-divisor and ass:source-count
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited ICLR result assumes non-Gaussian indecomposable confounders, 1≤k≤n, and full-column-rank loadings; it does not state the stronger greatest-Loewner-divisor condition or merely finite source dimension as its standard assumptions.

soundness_flags.label: ass:loading-bound
soundness_flags.one_line: Without a normalization of H, rescaling A and H makes ||A||op≤Amax representation-dependent, so it does not restrict observed laws or rule out exploding rescalings.

soundness_flags.label: def:fourier-model
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed class depends on Amax although Amax is absent from the model signature, so M(p,lambda,Lambda,c,C,Q,M8,q,preceq) does not determine its own membership condition.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 4 (minimax lower)
soundness_flags.one_line: The domains of the infima over covariance/fiber estimators, uniform honesty, confidence-set diameter, and the probability law meant by 'along the collision submodel' are not defined.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 5 (Laplace boundary)
soundness_flags.one_line: The supremum over P_X is unquantified, and C_Lap uses DF although the declared max-floor and spectral clipping maps are nondifferentiable at their kinks.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1 and Theorem 4
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The matching causal minimax and honest-diameter claims are conditional on an affirmative smooth-splice construction with all stated fixed-class checks.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Theorem 4 is pursued only conditional on the completed smooth-splice lower experiment; the upper confidence construction remains independent of it.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The finite-identifiability theorem requires nonconstant non-Gaussian confounders with no finite decomposition containing a Gaussian variable, lexicographically ordered loadings, linearly independent loading columns, and 1≤k≤n.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define estimator classes, honest confidence-set class, diameter event, and the exact collision-submodel quantifiers for the minimax theorem; define C_Lap through a global Lipschitz modulus or explicit piecewise bounds rather than an everywhere derivative.

Either derive the greatest-Gaussian-divisor property from primitive source assumptions or retag it as a justified novel identification condition; normalize source scales before retaining any loading bound.

Add a precise comparison with StriederDrton2024 and state a theorem that separates the proposed finite-sample mixed-noise fiber region from both equal-variance and partial-homoscedastic confidence regions.
Complete the smooth-splice handle with explicit densities and fixed constants, then state the lower-bound estimator and honest-set quantifier in the same model class as the upper theorem.

recommended_next_step: Revise the model and minimax domains, repair the assumption provenance and scale normalization, then refresh the structure-uncertainty literature comparison before advancing.
